(i) we propose a method for optimizing loss functions for a target task, which is a novel approach for meta-learning; (ii) we demonstrate that the proposed method can discover loss functions that are better suited for a target task than the standard cross- entropy loss; (iii) we demonstrate that training with the proposed loss function requires fewer steps, and results in lower test loss and test error; (iv) we demonstrate that our approach can reduce the amount of data needed for a given task

we introduce a novel loss function optimization technique, Genetic Loss-function Optimisation (GLO), that is able to find better loss functions for training a network than the standard cross-entrop loss.

We introduce Genetic Loss Function Optimization, a method for discovering loss functions that outperform standard cross entropy on image classification tasks, and that result in faster training and lower test error.
